notes.title: Our Kickstarter is live— help bring this world to life! ✨
notes.content:
We're thrilled to announce that our Kickstarter campaign for The Erebus Accord is now live!🎉

After countless hours of hard work and dedication, we're ready to take the next big step—and we would love for you to join us on this exciting journey.

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/boundarystudios/the-erebus-accord][img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45270197/12fa31a624937c9b79b8885892a915a576982ef9.png[/img][/url]

You'll find exclusive backer rewards, overall information about the project, and more ways to track and take part in the games' development! Here's a quick breakdown:

- [b]Early Bird Specials[/b] – Grab the game at a discounted price available only to early backers.
- [b]Beta Access[/b] – Be among the first to play and help shape the game's development.
- [b]Your Name in the Credits[/b] – Get recognized for your support in the game's official credits.
- [b]Design a Character[/b] – Collaborate with our team to create a character featured in the game.

📢 [b]Why Your Support Matters[/b]

[b]Your backing is more than just a pledge—it's a partnership[/b]. Every contribution brings us closer to realizing the full potential of The Erebus Accord, ensuring we deliver the immersive experience you deserve.

👐 [b]How You Can Help[/b]

If you're unable to pledge right now, you can still make a huge difference:

- [b]Share the Love[/b] – Spread the word by sharing our Kickstarter link on social media, gaming forums, or with friends who might be interested.
- [b]Join the Conversation[/b] – Leave a comment below with your thoughts, ideas, or just to show your excitement!
- [b]Stay Connected[/b]

[url=https://discord.gg/HEhcBdePN6][img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45270197/efb7ea0a17c3ef57d75c24185f24319d05b62da4.png[/img][/url]
[url=https://x.com/BoundaryStudios][img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45270197/71a342764d36e3ca37830f9e5aec3db7d787ea2e.png[/img][/url]

We can't thank you enough for your ongoing support. Together, we can make TEA something truly special. 🙏

See you on Kickstarter,
- Boundary Studios team.
